responsibility: Defines the 32/64-bit FreeBSD PowerPC64 target environment for rs6000, including ABI-width-dependent assembler/link specs, TOC and code-model support, endian-sensitive emulations, multilib defaults, type/layout rules, profiling conventions, EH encoding, and FreeBSD-specific library/startfile/link hooks. It is the main version of the FreeBSD header that adapts the Linux64-style rs6000 machinery to FreeBSD’s ppc64 ELF ABI and bi-arch behavior.
